text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Not really... I just had a little trouble falling asleep.
choice_data_list: Are you okay?! Don't push yourself too hard!
Are you okay!? Don't push yourself too hard, okay!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No, you're exaggerating...!
Don't look so terrified.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
This happens all the time... When I'm feeling sick
or nauseous, sometimes I just can't sleep.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, geez, why am I even talking about this...
You're really throwing me off my game, honestly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin seems sleep-deprived...
I should make sure she doesn't push herself too hard.
